basis: Cobalamin-processing defect; developmental delay and cytopenias 2/2, cardiac defects/pulmonary hypertension 1/2. Very small cohort; lesser skeletal findings omitted at cap.

decisions.haematologic: involved: anemia and neutropenia in 2/2 reflect downstream cobalamin dysfunction rather than a primary blood-cell disorder.

basis: Brain/renal defects define syndrome; marrow failure and Peters anomaly each 1/1 assessed. Pulmonary hypoplasia accompanies anhydramnios; sparse evidence and four-axis cap.

decisions.pulmonary: none: hypoplasia in 1/1 accompanies anhydramnios and may be secondary; documented marrow and anterior-eye defects take priority at the cap.
decisions.ocular: involved: Peters anomaly in 1/1 assessed is a structural anterior-eye defect with potential visual impairment; evidence is sparse.

basis: Urinary malformations, cortical atrophy and cardiomyopathy annotated 80-99%; intellectual disability ~60%. Minor skeletal dysmorphism lacks established functional damage.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: pectus carinatum, micrognathia and clinodactyly are common morphological findings, but substantial skeletal dysfunction is not established.

basis: Follicular hyperkeratosis and scarring alopecia define disease. Photophobia alone is insufficient; damaging corneal disease is recognized but not established in at least 30%.

decisions.ocular: none: keratitis and corneal dystrophy are reported without frequencies; characteristic photophobia does not establish damaging ocular disease in at least 30%.

basis: Defined by cranial, mandibular and acral skeletal anomalies. Macrostomia and external nasal dysmorphism do not establish gastrointestinal or airway dysfunction.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: macrostomia describes mouth shape; no oral tissue disease, impaired feeding or other gastrointestinal dysfunction is established.

basis: Defective bone resorption; anemia, optic compression and hearing impairment annotated 80-99%. Neurologic, dental and skin manifestations omitted at the four-axis cap.

decisions.haematologic: involved: marrow-space obliteration causes hematopoietic insufficiency; anemia is annotated 80-99%, secondary to skeletal disease.
decisions.neurologic: none at cap: hydrocephalus is annotated 80-99%; progressive degeneration is subtype-dependent. Marrow, visual and auditory dysfunction are retained.
decisions.otologic: involved: hearing impairment is annotated 80-99%, reflecting bony compression or structural compromise of auditory pathways.

basis: Intellectual disability, maxillary skeletal overgrowth and strabismus define syndrome; dental crowding and open bite affect 6/7, supporting oral involvement.

decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: dental crowding and open bite occur in 6/7 and represent dental malocclusion accompanying the defining maxillary skeletal abnormality.
decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: anterior maxillary protrusion is a defining skeletal abnormality, supported by maxillary hyperplasia in 6/7; not inferred from hypermobility alone.

basis: Amyloidogenic clonal plasma-cell disorder with protein deposition; renal dysfunction ~60-70%, cardiac involvement ~50-70%. Hepatic dysfunction and neuropathy usually below 30%.

decisions.haematologic: primary: systemic AL amyloidosis is an amyloidogenic clonal plasma-cell disorder; overt multiple myeloma is not required.

basis: Inherited medulloblastoma susceptibility alone establishes no organ injury; a future CNS tumor is a separate diagnosis, not an existing neurologic manifestation.

decisions.neurologic: none: the definition establishes inherited tumor risk, not an existing medulloblastoma, brain malformation or neurologic dysfunction.

basis: Endogenous cortisol causes myopathy/amyotrophy (30-99%), skin atrophy and immunodeficiency (30-79% each); hypertension is a separate secondary diagnosis.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: hypertension (30-79%) is generally a separately diagnosed secondary condition; nonspecific cardiovascular annotations establish no additional direct injury.
decisions.infectious_immune: involved: endogenous cortisol directly suppresses immune function; immunodeficiency is annotated 30-79%, beyond merely an increased future infection risk.
